item.description: President Trump said that he has agreed to convert plans for a massive triumphal arch into a "top grade Military Complex," equipped with snipers and drone storage.

item.title: Germany's Merz remains defiant after historic state elections defeat
item.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz​ acknowledged that the result was a "disaster" but said he would still move ahead with his government's reform agenda.

item.title: Trump says proposed 250-foot arch will be used as military complex
item.description: President Trump posted on social media early Sunday that his proposed 250-foot arch near Arlington National Cemetery will be used as a military complex, saying there will "large numbers of drones, plus Snipers, on both the roof and plaza areas, and additionally have and hold large quantities of sniper ammunition in storage."

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says fears of AI ending humanity are "not grounded on facts"
item.description: As some in the AI community have warned that the technology could end humanity, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang tells CBS News' Jo Ling Kent that that messaging is "quite frankly too much drama, irresponsible. It is not grounded in facts."

item.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang rejects AI extinction fear as "doomsday narratives"
item.description: Predictions that AI could destroy humanity in a few years are irresponsible and not based on science, Nvidia's co-founder told CBS News.

item.title: IBM vice chairman Gary Cohn says "consumer sentiment has turned quite negative" in U.S.
item.description: IBM vice chairman Gary Cohn, who served as an adviser in the first Trump administration, told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that "consumer sentiment has turned quite negative" in the U.S. amid rising gas prices, concerns about AI and high cost.

item.title: Rep. Salazar to Trump on Hispanic voters: "Preserve that fortune that you have brought" GOP
item.description: President Trump made historic gains with the Hispanic community in 2024 but his party faces a difficult midterm landscape amid his administration's immigration crackdown. Republican Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar, who released an ad this week distancing herself from Mr. Trump's immigration policy, urged the president to "please preserve that fortune that you have brought to the party."

item.description: Missed the second half of the show? Sen. Bill Cassidy, IBM vice chairman Gary Cohn and CBS News correspondent Jo Ling Kent's interview with NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang.

item.title: Rep. Ro Khanna says "international agreement" on AI is needed with China
item.description: California Democratic Rep. Ro Khanna told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that when President Trump meets his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping this week, Mr. Trump needs to make an "international agreement" with Xi that should include international monitoring on AI. He said this agreement should include "checks on the data centers where you can tell whether a model is being used for interference or training" and it should use "enforceable and verifiable tools."
